title: Playschool Franchise Opportunity
name: Giffy Kids Preschool & Daycare, 2 Franchisees, Est'd in 2021, Noida HQ
description: We operate 2 outlets, both registered as playschools, with a combined enrollment of 185 active students. We offer Playgroup, Nursery, LKG, and UKG classes for children aged 1–5 years. Both outlets also provide daycare services, with meals prepared in-house for the children. We have an incorporation and GST certificate.
